teams.detail: Lost to Cleveland in East playoffs as No. 1 seed (60-22). Isaiah Stewart drawing trade interest; Duren contract talks ongoing. Pre-draft workouts this week — hold pick No. 21.

Super Bowl LX champs. Mandatory minicamp opens today (Jun 9-11). Ring ceremony this week. Signed OT Bobby Hart. Veterans report Jul 22.

Diallo (15.7 ppg), Mandaquit, Muldrew left via portal. Added Watts (Texas Tech) and Venters (Gonzaga). Need 5-6 more players; at 8 scholarships under Sprinkle.

headlines.headline: SUMMER PORTAL ACTIVITY RESHAPES PROGRAMS — WASHINGTON LOSES THREE GUARDS
headlines.detail: Huskies drop to 8 scholarship players after Diallo, Mandaquit, Muldrew all enter portal. Coach Sprinkle added Watts and Venters but needs 5-6 more additions before fall.

headlines.headline: WEMBANYAMA 32/8/6 SILENCES MSG, SPURS WIN GAME 3 — SERIES 2-1 KNICKS
headlines.detail: Wembanyama shot 11-18 with 22 points at rim or FT line as SA wins 115-111 at MSG on Monday. Ends Knicks' 13-game win streak. Game 4 Wed June 10, 8:30 PM ET on ABC.

headlines.headline: 17 TEAMS OPEN MANDATORY MINICAMPS; SEAHAWKS BEGIN CHAMPIONSHIP DEFENSE
headlines.detail: Seattle opens minicamp today (Jun 9-11), signed OT Bobby Hart, ring ceremony this week. Giants have Dart and Winston adjusting to Harbaugh's offense. Season opens Sept. 9.

headlines.headline: INDIANA LANDS MICH. STATE WR NICK MARSH AS PROGRAMS FINALIZE ROSTERS
headlines.detail: Marsh ranks No. 3 WR and No. 12 overall in ESPN portal rankings. Texas adds No. 1 LB Rasheem Biles. Washington's receiver depth remains thin after four spring exits.
